urls.rationale: Chapter 42.17A historical home of WA lobbying disclosure (2015 ground truth); in 2025 the anchor text is 'Campaign Disclosure and Contribution' which suggests the lobbying portion may have migrated to Title 29B Ch. 29B.50, but pass-3 needs to fetch the section list to confirm whether any lobbying-side sections (e.g., the .600-series 'Registration of lobbyists' / 'Reporting by lobbyists') still remain here.

notes: WA 2025 Title 42 still contains Chapter 42.17A, but the anchor text changed (was 'Disclosure - Campaign Finance, Lobbying, Records' in 2015; now 'Campaign Disclosure and Contribution') AND Title 29B now carries an explicit 'Lobbying Disclosure and Restrictions' chapter (29B.50). Strong signal that 42.17A's lobbying provisions migrated to 29B.50 in the 2024-2025 reorg. Including 42.17A here so pass-3 can confirm by inspecting the actual section list; if pass-3 finds no .600-series lobbying sections remain, 42.17A drops out of proposed_urls.
